# PDFView

**Class:** `UltraCanvasPDFView` · **Group:** [Codes and documents](../Groups/Codes-and-documents.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Documents/UltraCanvasPDFView.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Documents/UltraCanvasPDFView.h) · `#include "Plugins/Documents/UltraCanvasPDFView.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A PDF on its own, with thumbnail strip, zoom and search-hit overlay (`UltraCanvasMediaViewer` embeds this for `.pdf`)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasPDFView> CreatePDFView( const std::string& id = "PDFView", int x = 0, int y = 0, int w = 600, int h = 800);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasPDFView(const std::string& id = "PDFView", float x = 0, float y = 0, float w = 600, float h = 800);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onPageChanged` | `std::function<void(int currentPage, int totalPages)> onPageChanged` | _Page changed_ |
| `onSearchResults` | `std::function<void(int hitCount)> onSearchResults` | _Search results_ |
| `onError` | `std::function<void(const std::string&)> onError` | _Error_ |
| `onDocumentChanged` | `std::function<void()> onDocumentChanged` | _Document changed_ |
| `onZoomChanged` | `std::function<void(float zoomPercent)> onZoomChanged` | _Zoom changed_ |
| `onActiveHitChanged` | `std::function<void(int activeHit, int totalHits)> onActiveHitChanged` | Fired whenever the active search hit changes (1-based index, total hits). |
| `onImageExtracted` | `std::function<void(const std::string& path, bool ok)> onImageExtracted` | Fired after the built-in "Extract Image" context-menu action completes. |
| `onSelectionChanged` | `std::function<void(int selectedChars)> onSelectionChanged` | Fired as the text selection changes (number of selected characters). |
| `onTextExported` | `std::function<void(const std::string& path, bool ok)> onTextExported` | Fired after a text export ("Export … Text") completes. |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

### enum `ZoomMode`

userZoom_ / effective zoom is an absolute scale where 1.0 == actual size (100%). Fit modes recompute the effective scale from the viewport on every render so the page keeps fitting when the view is resized.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `FitPage` |  |
| `FitWidth` |  |
| `Custom` |  |

### enum `WheelAction`

What the plain (unmodified) mouse wheel does over the page area. The other action is always on the same wheel with Ctrl held, so both stay reachable either way: Scroll - scroll the page, continuing into the next/previous page at its edges (the default); Ctrl+wheel zooms. Zoom - zoom about the pointer; Ctrl+wheel scrolls. Over the thumbnail strip the wheel always scrolls the strip.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Scroll` |  |
| `Zoom` |  |

### enum `MouseMode`

Left-drag behaviour: Pan (default, scrolls the page) or SelectText (character-level selection from the caret under the drag start to the caret under the drag end).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Pan` |  |
| `SelectText` |  |

### enum `ThumbnailNumberStyle`

How the page number is shown on each thumbnail: Caption - small label beneath the thumbnail (default) Overlay - large translucent number centred over the page

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Caption` |  |
| `Overlay` |  |

### enum `ThumbnailWidthMode`

How wide the page inventory's thumbnails are: Relative - a share of the view's own width (PDFViewStyle:: thumbStripWidthFraction, capped at thumbStripWidth), so the inventory grows and shrinks with the viewer. The default. Absolute - exactly GetThumbnailWidth() pixels, whatever the view's size, for hosts that want one fixed inventory width (the UltraFiler preview asks for 56 px). The strip adds thumbMargin on both sides; it still gives way when it would take more than half the view, so a very narrow pane keeps a page to look at.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Relative` |  |
| `Absolute` |  |

### struct `ThumbSlot`

One laid-out thumbnail: `y` is the slot top in strip-content coordinates (before thumbScroll_), `w`/`h` are the page image size — derived from the page's own aspect ratio, so the slot holds no unused space — and `captionH` is the label row beneath it (0 in Overlay numbering style).

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `y` | `int y = 0` |  |
| `w` | `int w = 0` |  |
| `h` | `int h = 0` |  |
| `captionH` | `int captionH = 0` |  |

### struct `CharLine`

A run of characters on one line; [first, last] are inclusive indices into pageChars_, and [y0, y1] is the line's vertical extent in page units.
